findings.text: follow-on: _uddb_header_value's bare-value alternative ([^\s]*) does not strip a terminator, so an unquoted unit returns with its separator: reproduced UNIT=A, -> 'A,' and UNIT=m, -> 'm,'. The observed UDDB headers quote the unit in one shot and leave it blank in another, so the measured case is unaffected, but any header whose unit is unquoted would land punctuation in the unit string. Trimming a trailing comma or treating the bare branch as a whole-token match would remove the latent case.

follow-on: the UDDB accessor and example_shot are derived from metadata_shot (the shot whose header carried the NAME) rather than the reference shot, so a channel whose header is readable at one shot but whose data only exists at another would be addressed and value-checked at the metadata shot. In the measured case PID 2842UA001 both names and value are read at E101163, so nothing is broken now; using the reference shot for the value read and citing the metadata shot only as provenance would decouple the two.

follow-on: the UDDB value read requests exactly the window [STIME, STIME+0.0001] and reports 'value unavailable' when it returns nothing, so a channel whose samples do not fall inside that 0.1 ms window reads as a failed check although the signal is valid. The measured channels start at STIME, so the control passed; widening the window or distinguishing 'no sample in window' from 'channel unreadable' would avoid a false negative in the check.

The focus file grew 24→28 tests.
justifications.evidence: the run carries a before/after graph census (before-discovery.log 6295 checked + 3 enriched EDDB unchanged after; UDDB 0→1 units, 0→6 descriptions; LCDB 0→6 units), a live source probe (field-probe.log: UDDB header NAME/UNIT and two LCDB namelists), a live value-read control (live-value-check.log raw_value/analysis_value, EXIT=0), and a per-field 8,657-row JSONL. I reconciled metadata-rows-final.jsonl independently: 188 UDDB / 8,469 LCDB rows, UDDB 1 unit and 6 descriptions, LCDB 6 units and 1,253 file-sourced descriptions, 90 rows whose source_unit_value is DEBUG and all 6 LCDB units sourced from XUNIT — matching the fragment's numbers exactly. I also reproduced the reviewed head's focused gate (28 passed, EXIT=0, repro-head-focused.log) in a scratch extraction.
justifications.fit: names describe the mechanism (_uddb_header_value, _lcdb_file_metadata, _lcdb_field_unit, uddb_header_shots, metadata_shot); no plan, sprint or ticket label appears in any symbol, filename, comment or commit subject; all seven commits carry a conventional subject and a body stating what changed and why.
justifications.goal_fidelity: §51 Node 1 asks that UDDB and LCDB signals carry units and descriptions, that the signal check read one value per database, and that a scoped landing put them in the graph. The gained commits read UDDB NAME/UNIT from uddbreadHeader (imas_codex/remote/scripts/enumerate_edas.py:307-320, imas_codex/discovery/signals/scanners/edas.py:298-320) and LCDB axis units plus dataset comments from the category .ldb namelists (enumerate_edas.py:401-436,481-511), and check_edas.py now reads a converted value for UDDB and a named analysis value for LCDB (check_edas.py:169-249). The scoped scan landed 8,657 of 8,657 rows and left the 6,298 EDDB rows at prior status. Coverage is thin but source-limited: UDDB 1 unit / 6 names of 188, LCDB 6 units / 1,253 comments of 8,469, with the run's own live probe showing the remaining UDDB units are blank and the remaining LCDB XUNIT/YUNIT are empty or DEBUG. The overall §51 done-when also names facility-config persistence and tests/config, which the plan assigns to Node 2, so this run cannot meet them and correctly does not claim to.
justifications.reuse: the change extends the existing EDASScanner and remote-script pair rather than adding a parallel path; the scoped landing reuses the existing persistence writer (scan reports signals_discovered 8,679 less 22 non-target equals the 8,657 written), and no second .ldb parser existed in the repo to reuse (rg for ldb parses finds only enumerate_edas.py).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --name-only 2bf9167..14eda62 lists exactly the five declared paths (the new evidence fragment plus edas.py, check_edas.py, enumerate_edas.py and the test file); the EDDB signal rows keep their checked/enriched status and no facility config is touched, which is correct because that persistence belongs to §51 Node 2.
